# Terminology

## Build

A voluntary NFT-like user object in X1 that records independent verified contribution layers.

## BLD

A normalized Build unit derived from redeemed Core NFT history.

Display unit:

1 BLD = 100,000,000 XEN burned through redeemed Core history

## XBP

XEN Burn Power.

A normalized unit derived from verified global XEN burn calls through:

XEN.burn(user, amount)

Display unit:

1 XBP = 100,000,000 XEN burned through XEN.burn(user, amount)

## XNTD Lock

A commitment requirement for Build records that received earned BLD through Core redeem.

The required lock amount is tied to the minimum Core L1 nominal of the current XC epoch.

## X1 Fee Contribution

Cumulative network fees paid by an address as fee payer on X1.

This tracks fee payment activity, not necessarily user activity.
